# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

The following versions are currently supported.

| Version | Supported |
| ------- | --------- |
| latest  | yes       |
| older   | no        |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a vulnerability, **do not open a public issue**. Please report it through one of the following channels.

1. Use GitHub Security Advisories (private vulnerability reporting), if enabled.
2. If unavailable, contact maintainers directly.

Please include the following in your report:

- Scope and affected versions/features
- Reproduction steps (and PoC if available)
- Expected impact and severity
- Any known mitigations or workarounds

## Response Process

- We usually acknowledge reports within 5 business days.
- We triage the report and may request additional details.
- After a fix is prepared, we coordinate disclosure timing and publish an advisory.

## Disclosure Policy

- To protect users, please avoid public disclosure before a fix is available.
- Disclosure timing is coordinated between maintainers and the reporter.
